high accuracy and ease of use.

factory automation.

(numerical controls), servos and lasers, and Robots to which such basic technologies are applied, as
well as Robomachines.

## Meet the Demands of Modern Fulfillment

##### Labor shortages, rising costs, and growing customer expectations are pushing logistics
##### operations to their limits. Today’s warehouses need more than equipment - they need
##### intelligent, integrated solutions.

### A Global Leader in Warehouse Automation.

We design, build, integrate, and support intelligent systems that boost efficiency and productivity
across distribution centers. Our software-first approach combines modular architecture, cloud
migration, and pre-built value to deliver seamless, future-ready operations.

Intelligrated delivers end-to-end design, installation, integration, and lifecycle support for
warehouse automation systems. Our solutions integrate cloud-native and hybrid WES software,
robotics, simulation tools, and more, providing optimized performance without disrupting your
workflows.

## Meet the Demands of Modern Fulfillment

##### Labor shortages, rising costs, and growing customer expectations are pushing logistics
##### operations to their limits. Today’s warehouses need more than equipment - they need
##### intelligent, integrated solutions.

[Demanding Throughput]

##### Demanding Throughput

Today's market pressures reduce the time for maintenance and modifications

[Segmented Architecture Risks]

##### Segmented Architecture Risks

Age-diverse systems pose downtime and efficiency risks


[Evolving Material Handling]

##### Evolving Material Handling

Integration cannot rely solely on mechanical capabilities; sustainable value requires innovation

**WHO WE ARE**

### A Global Leader in Warehouse Automation.

We design, build, integrate, and support intelligent systems that boost efficiency and productivity
across distribution centers. Our software-first approach combines modular architecture, cloud
migration, and pre-built value to deliver seamless, future-ready operations.

**WHAT WE DO**

### End-to-End Automation, Delivered.

Intelligrated delivers end-to-end design, installation, integration, and lifecycle support for
warehouse automation systems. Our solutions integrate cloud-native and hybrid WES software,
robotics, simulation tools, and more, providing optimized performance without disrupting your
workflows.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

## One digital twin, clear operational insight

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]
[A person wearing a headset interacts with a holographic display of 3D models and data
visualizations.]

payloads up to 35 kg, reach up to 1750 mm and deployment in minutes. Trusted across industries
including electronics, metal fabrication, logistics and education, our [collaborative robotic arm
solutions][19] help manufacturers increase productivity, reduce downtime and accelerate ROI.

Collaborative robots handle repetitive and ergonomically challenging tasks with precision and
consistency – hour after hour, shift after shift. Designed for diverse production settings, cobots

### Flexibility

Moving the cobot to new processes is fast and easy, giving you the agility to automate almost any
manual task, including those with small batches or fast changeovers. Cobots are able to re-use
programs for recurrent tasks.

[Quality]

is accurate and reliable. This level of precision reduces variability, minimizes defects, and helps
maintain the highest standards of product quality throughout production.

# Unlock the Potential of Your Warehouse with Armstrong Dematic

[image]

## Celebrating 27+ years of Innovation, Teamwork and Resilience

For over a quarter century, Armstrong Dematic has been the trusted name in intralogistics and
warehouse automation industry. We stand at the forefront of innovation, delivering intelligent
solutions that transform supply chains at scale.

Powered by global technology leadership & deep domain expertise, we excel in executing large scale,
multi-solution projects with precision and reliability. Our AI-driven, data-powered platforms set
new benchmarks for efficiency, enabling businesses across industries to thrive in an era of
intelligent automation.

Thus when complexity calls for excellence, Armstrong Dematic is the One-stop-Partner that turns
ambition into achievement.

#### CASE STUDY: FOOD & BEVERAGE INDUSTRY

## Turning Challenges into Competitive Advantages

In the dynamic food and beverage industry, Haldiram's has shown how to transform obstacles into
opportunities. Faced with limited space and slower throughput, they partnered with Armstrong Dematic
to enhance their operations.Together, we integrated 5 Asterope Stacker Robots into their Noida
warehouse, leading to impressive results:
* 280 pallets per hour throughput
* Seamless future planning powered by AI-driven BI softwares
* Streamlined dispatch operations
* Maximum space optimization through dense storage
* 70% reduction in manpower

Watch the video to see how we’ve set new standards for efficiency and growth

#### CASE STUDY: PARCEL & COURIER INDUSTRY

## Armstrong Dematic’s Advanced Cross Belt Sorter: POLARIS

Are you ready to embark upon a gripping virtual tour & witness the exciting journey of a parcel from
its source to the destination? Experience our next generation warehousing solutions coupled with
business intelligence software which not just boosts throughput by 4x but also decreases the
manpower requirement by 3x. This makes ‘Polaris’ an ideal solution for businesses struggling with
low throughput, mis-sorts, under-utilization of space & slow operations at the fulfilment centres.

[Watch Now [arrow img]][56]

#### CASE STUDY: FMCG Industry

## Revolutionizing Haldiram’s Operations - A Success Story

Tap to see our innovative End of line solution, consisting of advanced software, robotic
palletizers, sorters, and conveyors, empowering Haldiram’s operations. The strategic implementation
provides them multiple benefits such as
* Maximum floor space utilization
* Increased throughput
* 100% visibility
* Accurate tracking

## [More Automatic Guided Vehicles Manufacturers][88]


### Automated Guided Vehicle Supplier Directory Overview

Find, compare, and connect with automated guided vehicle manufacturers through a supplier directory
built to help buyers source the right automation partner for material movement, pallet transport,
cart handling, towing, and line support. This page is designed for teams that need to browse AGV
manufacturers, review AGV suppliers, and compare automated guided vehicles for warehousing,
manufacturing, automotive production, healthcare logistics, food processing, and distribution
operations. Whether you are planning a first deployment or expanding an AGV system, this directory
helps buyers quickly identify suppliers by equipment type, application focus, and operational fit.

### Forklift-Style Automated Guided Vehicles

Forklift-style automated guided vehicles are built for pallet pickup, drop-off, stacking support,
and repetitive load transfer in warehouses, factories, and shipping areas. Buyers often compare
these systems when they need automated guided vehicle manufacturers that support higher payloads,
aisle navigation, and safer material movement around workers and fixed equipment.

### Tugger and Cart-Based AGV Systems

Tugger and cart-based automated guided vehicles are used to pull trailers, move work-in-process
materials, and feed production areas on scheduled routes. These AGV vehicles are common in
manufacturing plants, automotive operations, and large assembly environments where continuous parts
flow, route repeatability, and predictable delivery timing matter.

### Unit Load Vehicles and Automated Guided Carts

Unit load vehicles and automated guided carts support tote movement, pallet transfer, and
station-to-station transport across distribution, packaging, electronics, and pharmaceutical
operations. Buyers searching AGV manufacturers and AGV companies often look at load type, routing
method, and facility layout to determine whether a standard vehicle or more specialized automated
guided vehicle system makes the most sense.

### Autonomous Guided Vehicles and AGV Robots

More advanced autonomous guided vehicle and AGV robot platforms support flexible navigation,
obstacle detection, and software-driven fleet coordination. These systems are frequently used in
facilities that want greater route adaptability, better traffic control, and easier integration with
warehouse software, manufacturing controls, and changing workflows.

### Industry Applications of AGV Systems

Automotive plants rely on automated guided vehicles to move parts, kits, and assemblies between
storage areas and production cells with predictable timing. Warehousing and distribution operations
use AGV robots for pallet transport, replenishment, and order movement across high-volume
facilities. Food and beverage processors depend on automated guided vehicle systems for repeatable
material flow in fast-paced production environments. Healthcare facilities use autonomous guided
vehicles to move supplies, carts, and support materials through controlled internal routes.
Electronics and pharmaceutical manufacturers use AGV vehicle platforms where clean handling,
accuracy, and traceable movement are essential.

### Production Volume and System Design Fit

Production volume should shape the starting point of any supplier review. Buyers comparing AGV
suppliers should define throughput, shift patterns, load frequency, and route density before
narrowing options, because a low-volume transport task and a continuous high-volume workflow require
very different system designs.

### Fixed Route vs Flexible Navigation Systems

Process type matters just as much as speed. Some operations need fixed, repeatable routes for line
feeding or pallet transfer, while others benefit from more flexible autonomous guided vehicle or AMR
manufacturers that support dynamic rerouting, variable tasks, and mixed traffic conditions.

### Integration with Existing Facility Systems

Integration planning should happen early. Buyers should ask whether an AGV system can connect with
existing conveyors, racking layouts, software controls, scanners, safety systems, and production
scheduling tools without creating bottlenecks or forcing major floor changes.

### Compliance, Safety, and Documentation Requirements

Inspection, documentation, and compliance review should also be part of vendor evaluation.
Facilities in regulated or quality-sensitive industries often need suppliers that can support
validation requirements, safety documentation, testing standards, and clear maintenance practices
alongside the equipment itself.

### Choosing the Right AGV Manufacturer

Supplier specialization can separate a workable project from an expensive mismatch. When reviewing
AGV manufacturers, AGV companies, AMR companies, or AMR robot companies, buyers should compare
application experience, payload focus, navigation approach, support responsiveness, and ability to
scale from one vehicle to a larger fleet.

### FAQ

#### How do I find automated guided vehicle manufacturers for my application?

Start by narrowing the search by load type, route style, facility conditions, and industry use case.
A supplier directory is most useful when buyers compare manufacturers by system capability rather
than by marketing claims alone. Look for companies that clearly match your material flow,
integration needs, and expected throughput.

AGV manufacturers typically focus on vehicles that follow defined routes or controlled navigation

### Automated Guided Vehicle Supplier Directory Overview

Find, compare, and connect with automated guided vehicle manufacturers through a supplier directory
built to help buyers source the right automation partner for material movement, pallet transport,
cart handling, towing, and line support. This page is designed for teams that need to browse AGV
manufacturers, review AGV suppliers, and compare automated guided vehicles for warehousing,
manufacturing, automotive production, healthcare logistics, food processing, and distribution
operations. Whether you are planning a first deployment or expanding an AGV system, this directory
helps buyers quickly identify suppliers by equipment type, application focus, and operational fit.

### Forklift-Style Automated Guided Vehicles

Forklift-style automated guided vehicles are built for pallet pickup, drop-off, stacking support,
and repetitive load transfer in warehouses, factories, and shipping areas. Buyers often compare
these systems when they need automated guided vehicle manufacturers that support higher payloads,
aisle navigation, and safer material movement around workers and fixed equipment.

### Tugger and Cart-Based AGV Systems

Tugger and cart-based automated guided vehicles are used to pull trailers, move work-in-process
materials, and feed production areas on scheduled routes. These AGV vehicles are common in
manufacturing plants, automotive operations, and large assembly environments where continuous parts
flow, route repeatability, and predictable delivery timing matter.

### Unit Load Vehicles and Automated Guided Carts

Unit load vehicles and automated guided carts support tote movement, pallet transfer, and
station-to-station transport across distribution, packaging, electronics, and pharmaceutical
operations. Buyers searching AGV manufacturers and AGV companies often look at load type, routing
method, and facility layout to determine whether a standard vehicle or more specialized automated
guided vehicle system makes the most sense.

### Autonomous Guided Vehicles and AGV Robots

More advanced autonomous guided vehicle and AGV robot platforms support flexible navigation,
obstacle detection, and software-driven fleet coordination. These systems are frequently used in
facilities that want greater route adaptability, better traffic control, and easier integration with
warehouse software, manufacturing controls, and changing workflows.

### Industry Applications of AGV Systems

Automotive plants rely on automated guided vehicles to move parts, kits, and assemblies between
storage areas and production cells with predictable timing. Warehousing and distribution operations
use AGV robots for pallet transport, replenishment, and order movement across high-volume
facilities. Food and beverage processors depend on automated guided vehicle systems for repeatable
material flow in fast-paced production environments. Healthcare facilities use autonomous guided
vehicles to move supplies, carts, and support materials through controlled internal routes.
Electronics and pharmaceutical manufacturers use AGV vehicle platforms where clean handling,
accuracy, and traceable movement are essential.

### Production Volume and System Design Fit

Production volume should shape the starting point of any supplier review. Buyers comparing AGV
suppliers should define throughput, shift patterns, load frequency, and route density before
narrowing options, because a low-volume transport task and a continuous high-volume workflow require
very different system designs.

### Fixed Route vs Flexible Navigation Systems

Process type matters just as much as speed. Some operations need fixed, repeatable routes for line
feeding or pallet transfer, while others benefit from more flexible autonomous guided vehicle or AMR
manufacturers that support dynamic rerouting, variable tasks, and mixed traffic conditions.

### Integration with Existing Facility Systems

Integration planning should happen early. Buyers should ask whether an AGV system can connect with
existing conveyors, racking layouts, software controls, scanners, safety systems, and production
scheduling tools without creating bottlenecks or forcing major floor changes.

### Compliance, Safety, and Documentation Requirements

Inspection, documentation, and compliance review should also be part of vendor evaluation.
Facilities in regulated or quality-sensitive industries often need suppliers that can support
validation requirements, safety documentation, testing standards, and clear maintenance practices
alongside the equipment itself.

### Choosing the Right AGV Manufacturer

Supplier specialization can separate a workable project from an expensive mismatch. When reviewing
AGV manufacturers, AGV companies, AMR companies, or AMR robot companies, buyers should compare
application experience, payload focus, navigation approach, support responsiveness, and ability to
scale from one vehicle to a larger fleet.

Autotec engineers the equipment and workflows around autonomous mobile robots. From top modules and
interface conveyors to complete material flow solutions, we help connect AMRs to real manufacturing
processes. [Learn More][85]

Autotec designs and integrates complete roll handling systems for demanding manufacturing
environments. Our solutions improve material flow, reduce manual handling, and support safe,
reliable production. [Learn More][86]

Autotec engineers custom robotic automation for palletizing, material handling, and complex
manufacturing applications. We combine robotics, controls, and system integration to solve real
production challenges. [Learn More][87]

support, preventative maintenance, spare parts, system optimization, upgrades, and training. [Learn
More][88]

Autotec Solutions designs and integrates custom automation systems for manufacturers with demanding
material handling, robotics, roll handling, AMR, and lifecycle support needs. Our team combines
engineering, controls, robotics, and installation experience to deliver systems built around each
customer’s process.

automation solutions for applications where standard equipment may not fit.

experienced automation team.

## Beacon Robot**Who we are?**

Suzhou Beacon Robot Technology Co., Ltd., established in 2018 and located at Yuanhe High-Tech
Intelligent Manufacturing Park, is a company dedicated to the research and development, design,
assembly, sales, implementation, and after-sales services of a full range of intelligent mobile
handling robots (AMR/AGV). The company primarily provides unmanned industrial intelligent
warehousing and material handling system solutions for its users.
[see more ][154]

### Beacon Robot Empowers Smart Logistics Upgrade for a European Fastener Company’s Southeast Asian
### Factory

In recent years, the wave of automation upgrades in Southeast Asia's manufacturing sector has
continued to gain momentum. Industries such as fasteners and precision hardware are increasingly
plagued by challenges including labor shortages, inefficiencies in manual **material handling**, and
insufficient production line flexibility. Recently, Beacon Robot successfully completed the delivery
of an automated material handling transformation project for a European fastener company's factory
in Southeast Asia. Leveraging composite collaborative robotic AMRs (Autonomous Mobile Robots), the
solution enables fully unmanned operations—from autonomous transport of workshop bins to automatic
machine loading and unloading.

As one of ****Russia's leading food and FMCG retail enterprises****, the company operates thousands
of stores nationwide across multiple formats, including convenience stores, supermarkets, and
discount outlets. Its business spans the entire supply chain, from procurement, warehousing, and
distribution to retail. With continuous business expansion and rapid growth in e-commerce, its
distribution centers are facing ****unprecedented logistical pressure****. Tens of thousands of
store orders ****must be picked, handled, sorted, and dispatched within tight timeframes****,

logistics systems.

Suzhou Beacon Robot Technology Co., Ltd., established in 2018 and located at Yuanhe High-Tech
Intelligent Manufacturing Park, is a company dedicated to the research and development, design,
assembly, sales, implementation, and after-sales services of a full range of intelligent mobile
handling robots (AMR/AGV). The company primarily provides unmanned industrial intelligent
warehousing and material handling system solutions for its users.

## Benefits of an Automated Industrial Parts Washer

An industrial parts washer is a heavy-duty, automated cleaning system that removes contaminants —
such as oils, coolants, metal chips, and carbon buildup — from manufactured components, engines, and
equipment. Using a combination of heat, pressure, and cleaning detergents, these systems replace
slow, manual scrubbing with fast, repeatable cleaning that meets stringent cleanliness standards.
* ### Reduced Downtime
  
  Facilities report up to 50% faster turnaround compared to manual washing
* ### Consistent Quality
  
  Controlled wash, rinse, and dry cycles clean every part to the same standard – no operator
  fatigue, no variability
* ### Lower operating costs
  
  Filtration and water recycling cut consumable use by up to 30%
* ### Sustainability gains
  
  Water reuse and biodegradable detergents reduce waste and environmental impact
* ### Operator safety
  
  Enclosed, automated systems limit operator contact with solvents, hot fluids, and contaminants

such as oils, coolants, metal chips, and carbon buildup — from manufactured components, engines, and
equipment. Using a combination of heat, pressure, and cleaning detergents, these systems replace
slow, manual scrubbing with fast, repeatable cleaning that meets stringent cleanliness standards.
* ### Reduced Downtime
  
  Facilities report up to 50% faster turnaround compared to manual washing
* ### Consistent Quality
  
  Controlled wash, rinse, and dry cycles clean every part to the same standard – no operator
  fatigue, no variability
* ### Lower operating costs
  
  Filtration and water recycling cut consumable use by up to 30%
* ### Sustainability gains
  
  Water reuse and biodegradable detergents reduce waste and environmental impact
* ### Operator safety
  
  Enclosed, automated systems limit operator contact with solvents, hot fluids, and contaminants

* ## ABOUT CAROLINA HANDLING
  1. Carolina Handling is the trusted intralogistics material handling partner of thousands of
     companies across the Southeast. Our portfolio of products extends well beyond innovative
     forklift offerings to include comprehensive automation solutions that include consulting,
     design, engineering, installation and integration expertise – all in one place.
     
     Long recognized for superior field service support, Carolina Handling offers elite customer
     service before, during and after the sale.
  2. [Logos of 1996 Olympics, MHEDA MVP Award, and Raymond Dealer of Distiniction]           
[Learn More About Carolina Handling][204]

## What is Intralogistics?

Simply put, intralogistics is the management of your internal supply chain. It’s the planning and
controlling of the flow of materials, information and people within your facility to achieve optimum
results.

## Our Products

### Carolina Handling’s Intralogistics Solutions Group offers a comprehensive range of services,
### including consulting, design, engineering, installation and integration – all in one place.


 
* [Carollina Handling automation system with conveyors and modulas.]
  
  ### Automation and Technology
  
  As your intralogistics consultant, Carolina Handling helps you discover the best ways to move more
  product, faster and at less cost. Being vendor agnostic, we identify the best automation
  technology and equipment to address challenges unique to your operations.
  
  
  [Browse Our Automation Products][205]
* [Raymond Forklifts in a warehouse]
  
  ### Warehouse Equipment
  
  From floor scrubbers to forklifts and racking to robots, Carolina Handling offers a full range of
  equipment to keep your warehouse running. We maintain partnerships with the most trusted brands in
  the business, giving you the convenience and streamlining of a single-source provider.
  
   
  
  [Browse Our Warehouse Equipment][206]
  
* [Carolina Handling Technician repairing a forklift.]
  
  ### Service and Parts
  
  Parts availability and fast response times define our post-sale support, with seasoned technicians
  delivering consistent results. With an average breakdown-call response time of 1.1 hours and a 98%
  renewal rate for service agreements, Carolina Handling leads the industry.
  
  [Browse Our Aftermarket Support][207]
  
  
* [Carolina Handling associates consulting in warehouse.]
  
  ### Consulting
  
  When it comes to optimizing operations, you want a trusted partner with the expertise and
  experience to guide your decision-making. As your intralogistics consultant, Carolina Handling
  works alongside your operations team to identify and implement the most efficient processes and
  procedures.
  
   
  
  [Browse Our Professional Services][208]

## Proven Fleet Service Programs

### Carolina Handling offers three tiers of Fleet Services, all designed to keep you up and running.

  - Preston Russell, Director of Business Development & Marketing

* ## ABOUT CAROLINA HANDLING
  1. Carolina Handling is the trusted intralogistics material handling partner of thousands of
     companies across the Southeast. Our portfolio of products extends well beyond innovative
     forklift offerings to include comprehensive automation solutions that include consulting,
     design, engineering, installation and integration expertise – all in one place.
     
     Long recognized for superior field service support, Carolina Handling offers elite customer
     service before, during and after the sale.

## What is Intralogistics?

Simply put, intralogistics is the management of your internal supply chain. It’s the planning and
controlling of the flow of materials, information and people within your facility to achieve optimum
results.

## Our Products

### Carolina Handling’s Intralogistics Solutions Group offers a comprehensive range of services,
### including consulting, design, engineering, installation and integration – all in one place.


 
* [Carollina Handling automation system with conveyors and modulas.]
  
  ### Automation and Technology
  
  As your intralogistics consultant, Carolina Handling helps you discover the best ways to move more
  product, faster and at less cost. Being vendor agnostic, we identify the best automation
  technology and equipment to address challenges unique to your operations.
  
  
  [Browse Our Automation Products][205]
* [Raymond Forklifts in a warehouse]
  
  ### Warehouse Equipment
  
  From floor scrubbers to forklifts and racking to robots, Carolina Handling offers a full range of
  equipment to keep your warehouse running. We maintain partnerships with the most trusted brands in
  the business, giving you the convenience and streamlining of a single-source provider.
  
   
  
  [Browse Our Warehouse Equipment][206]
  
* [Carolina Handling Technician repairing a forklift.]
  
  ### Service and Parts
  
  Parts availability and fast response times define our post-sale support, with seasoned technicians
  delivering consistent results. With an average breakdown-call response time of 1.1 hours and a 98%
  renewal rate for service agreements, Carolina Handling leads the industry.
  
  [Browse Our Aftermarket Support][207]
  
  
* [Carolina Handling associates consulting in warehouse.]
  
  ### Consulting
  
  When it comes to optimizing operations, you want a trusted partner with the expertise and
  experience to guide your decision-making. As your intralogistics consultant, Carolina Handling
  works alongside your operations team to identify and implement the most efficient processes and
  procedures.
  
   
  
  [Browse Our Professional Services][208]

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized

**Wobble Laser Welding: Beam Patterns, Gap Bridging, And Process Optimization**

What Is Wobble Laser Welding? Wobble laser welding superimposes a high-frequency beam oscillation on
the main travel path. Galvanometer mirrors or another optical steering mechanism move the laser spot
in a circle, line, ellipse, figure-eight, or custom pattern while the robot or machine advances
along the seam. A conventional weld concentrates energy near one moving point. Wobble spreads the
interaction over a defined width and repeatedly remelts portions of the pool. This can change
penetration shape, surface appearance, gas escape, wetting, and the amount of joint variation the
process can tolerate. The technique is also called beam oscillation or beam weaving. It should not
be confused with mechanically weaving the complete welding head, which is slower an...

**Offline Robot Programming And Digital Twins For High-Mix Welding Production**

What Is Offline Robot Programming? Offline robot programming, or OLP, is the creation and simulation
of robot programs on a computer instead of teaching every point on the production robot. Engineers
import part and fixture geometry, select a robot and tool, define paths, simulate motion, and
translate the result into controller-specific code. Traditional online teaching occupies the
physical cell. The programmer jogs the robot to each position, stores points, adjusts speed, and
proves the sequence at reduced speed. This remains necessary for final verification, but it becomes

What Is Wobble Laser Welding? Wobble laser welding superimposes a high-frequency beam oscillation on
the main travel path. Galvanometer mirrors or another optical steering mechanism move the laser spot
in a circle, line, ellipse, figure-eight, or custom pattern while the robot or machine advances
along the seam. A conventional weld concentrates energy near one moving point. Wobble spreads the
interaction over a defined width and repeatedly remelts portions of the pool. This can change

[Parcel Handling][Parcel Handling]
[Package Handling][38]
DCS’s design and engineering team has more than 40 years of experience creating unique parcel
handling systems for diverse customer applications. With installations including semi-automated
handling in small city distribution centers and fully automated, integrated hubs with advanced
conveyor and sorter equipment, DCS routinely thinks outside the box.
[ Learn More ][39]
[E-Commerce Multi Channel Fullfillment][E-Commerce Multi Channel Fullfillment]
[E-Commerce and Multi-Channel Fulfillment][40]
DCS designs and implements end-to-end warehouse automation solutions for e-commerce and
multi-channel retailers that address numerous workflow challenges. This includes solutions for
receiving, putaway, storage, replenishment, order fulfillment, picking, packing, sortation, and
outbound shipping. Our custom integrated warehouse, distribution, and fulfillment systems draw from
a deep pool of conventional, semi-automated, and automated material handling technologies.
[ Learn More ][41]
[DCS][DCS]
[Various Distribution Applications][42]
Whether an operation is considering the construction of a new distribution or fulfillment center, or
a retrofit or expansion of an existing facility, it’s important to create a solution that fits the
overarching supply chain strategy. DCS has four decades of experience designing and integrating
comprehensive, end-to-end material handling solutions that meet a multitude of operational goals.
Whether conventional, semi-automated, or fully automated, DCS can help your organization implement a
custom solution that meets its goals while maximizing return on investment (ROI).
[ Learn More ][43]

[Consulting][Consulting]
[Supply Chain Consulting][53]
The DCS Supply Chain Consulting team offers a range of services to help your operations address the
challenges it faces. Working in partnership with you, DCS consultants analyze your business data-
existing workforce, workflow processes, inventory, order data, operations, and more- to determine a
strategy that addresses your unique needs. Whether you need an operations assessment, process
improvement recommendations, or distribution design services, DCS consultants will help guide you to
the material handling system or operational solution that best meets your current and future needs,
as well as your budget.
[ Learn More ][54]
[Customer Support][Customer Support]
[Customer Support][55]
Keeping your warehouse operations and material handling systems running smoothly and at the peak of
productivity are the goals of DCS’ Customer Service Team. By partnering with DCS, your warehouse
automation solution is supported from commissioning to end of life. You’ll receive comprehensive
in-house training of your personnel, including specialized training of your designated internal
system expert. Plus, DCS offers a complete package of spare parts and expert system troubleshooting
support from qualified engineers dedicated to your installation.
[ Learn More ][56]
[System Design and Integration][System Design and Integration]
[System Design & Integration][57]
DCS offers a broad range of material handling equipment and automated system design, installation,
and integration services for a multitude of projects. These include retrofits, expansions, upgrades,
and more. While every project is unique, our system design and execution processes are the same,
encompassing meticulous attention to detail, frequent communication, and a dedicated partnership
with our clients.
[ Learn More ][58]

## About Us

**EXCELLENCE ROBOTICS AUTOMATION PVT LTD (ERAA PVT LTD)** is a Pune, India based company, leading in
robotics and automation world, catering to various industries like Automotive, Non Automotive
General Industries **EXCELLENCE ROBOTICS AUTOMATION PVT LTD (ERAA PVT LTD)** has world wide customer
base

**EXCELLENCE ROBOTICS AUTOMATION PVT LTD (ERAA PVT LTD)** is Turnkey Solution provider for all kind
of Industrial Robotics and Automation

We have several years of experience and research to derive the successful solutions catering to
every market need

**EXCELLENCE ROBOTICS AUTOMATION PVT LTD (ERAA PVT LTD)** is one stop shop for all kind of
Industrial robotic solutions for Line Automation, Simulation, Robot services, Robotic work Cell
Lines for Spot welding, MIG welding, Material handling, Sealing, Painting, Assembly, Inspection,
Hemming and many more

## Our Services

##### Robotic Service

We offer a comprehensive range of robotic services for both offline and online programming. With
offline programming, we provide complete line simulation and process development, including
simulation inputs, data deliverables, process optimization, and tool selection for various
applications such as spot welding, material handling, laser cutting, and more. On the other hand,
our online programming expertise involves hands-on robot setup, tool calibration, application
configuration, and process validation, ensuring quality improvement, cycle time optimization, and
production support. Whether offline or online, our services cover a wide array of applications,
including welding, assembly, inspection, painting, and more.

##### PLC Service

Our expertise extends from small-scale to large-scale systems, ranging from a few I/Os to several
thousand I/Os. Our solutions include hot standby redundant PLC and SCADA systems, wireless
communication, data logging, detailed reporting, and graphical representation of data. With careful
selection of products such as PLC, SCADA, HMI, VFD, and Servo, we design tailored solutions that
deliver optimal performance, saving time and costs. We excel in utilizing PLCs for digital and
analog input handling, implementing communication protocols like Hardwiring, Device Net, Profi bus,
and Ethernet, enabling seamless interaction between shop floor and top floor for monitoring and
control.

##### Control Service

Our control services encompass a comprehensive range of offerings. This includes panel design,
manufacturing, and assembly, as well as on-field wiring and piping for seamless integration.
Additionally, our design services cover process study, layout design, concept design, manufacturing
design, CAD model design, detailing and drafting, feasibility study, ergonomics, and reverse
engineering. With our expertise, we ensure efficient control system implementation, precise panel
manufacturing, and meticulous design processes that adhere to industry standards, resulting in
optimized functionality and streamlined operations.

##### Mechanical Service

Our mechanical services encompass a wide range of expertise. We specialize in mechanical design,
utilizing advanced software to create innovative and efficient solutions. Our manufacturing
capabilities ensure precise fabrication and assembly of mechanical components. We provide
comprehensive layout design services, optimizing space utilization and workflow efficiency.
Additionally, our process study enables us to analyze and optimize mechanical processes, identifying
areas for improvement. With our integrated mechanical services, we deliver high-quality designs,
streamlined manufacturing processes, and optimized layouts for enhanced productivity and operational
effectiveness.

## CRX-10*i*A/L Paint

The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the perfect industrial solution for manufacturers new to robotics.
This product line includes the CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot, which precisely dispenses materials for
uniform and reliable application in the paint, liquid and powder coatings, and fiberglass
industries. The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the first and only cobot certified for painting in
accordance with U.S. safety standards and is the best option on the market for precision dispensing
applications.

## FANUC and Google: Advancing Manufacturing Intelligence

FANUC is collaborating with Google to bring cloud-native artificial intelligence capabilities to
manufacturing plants, enabling smarter automation and predictive analytics across all production
environments.

[ Read the Announcement ][133]
[Image 800x600]
Collaborative Series

## CRX-10*i*A/L Paint

The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the perfect industrial solution for manufacturers new to robotics.
This product line includes the CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot, which precisely dispenses materials for
uniform and reliable application in the paint, liquid and powder coatings, and fiberglass
industries. The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the first and only cobot certified for painting in
accordance with U.S. safety standards and is the best option on the market for precision dispensing
applications.

[ CRX-10iA/L Paint ][134]
Collaboration

## FANUC Accelerates Physical AI in Industrial Robotics, Leveraging NVIDIA Technologies

FANUC is combining its global leadership in robotics with NVIDIA’s AI computing and simulation
platforms to deliver intelligent and adaptable automation. This collaboration integrates ROBOGUIDE
with NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Omniverse to create photorealistic digital twins, and enables robots to
interpret voice commands and automatically generate code.

Pointe Precision machines mission‑critical aerospace parts with ultra‑tight tolerances. To ensure

# Technology Insights and Research for the Housing Sector

[Free Subscription][16]
[research]

## Research

17+ years of business and technology related market intelligence reports for the housing sector.

[Reports][17]

[publications]

## Magazine

Gain vital insights from the leading technology news and information publication for the housing
sector.

[Magazine][18]

[events]

## Events

Gather business intelligence at our technology business events, and the No.1 technology conference
in the sector.

[Events][19]

[recruitment]

## Recruitment

Find the latest technology and senior management jobs in housing on our job board.

[Jobs][20]

## Data Matters 2026

Good data and sound data management strategies must be the foundation of all housing providers'
operations, and Housing Technology's Data Matters 2026 is back for its fifth consecutive year to
explore exactly that. Join us on 22 September 2026 at the IET Birmingham: Austin Court for an
unmissable day with housing providers sharing real-world experiences, hard-won recommendations and
tangible results.

[Find out more][21]

## work in housing? You should subscribe to our magazine

If you want to stay ahead and gather invaluable business intelligence, join thousands of
professionals by becoming a Housing Technology subscriber today.
* Receive our beautifully printed bi-monthly magazine directly in the post.
* Access to the digital copy of the magazine.
* Unparalleled business intelligence and the latest news.
* Exclusive email invites to our events and workshops.
* Early access offers for our industry reports and events.
* Invites to contribute articles and share your knowledge.
* **Completely free.**

[Free Subscription][22]


## Housing Technology Conference 2027

Join us in March 2027 (9 - 11) at the East Midlands Conference Centre in Nottingham for the UK’s
premier IT event for the social housing sector. Whether you're shaping IT strategy or managing
frontline operations, Housing Technology 2027 is the must-attend event to stay ahead in a
fast-evolving landscape.

[Find out more][23]

## Housing Technology Awards 2026

The Housing Technology Awards 2026 celebrated an outstanding standard of achievement from across the
social housing sector. Held during the Housing Technology 2026 conference and executive forum in
Nottingham, the awards recognised the very best examples of innovation, ambition and hard work
delivered by housing technology teams throughout the year.

For full details of the winners, highly commended and commended entries in each category, please
click More Info below.

This year’s awards covered six categories:
* Artificial Intelligence
* Customer Services
* Cyber Security
* Digital Transformation
* Innovation
* IT Team of the Year

[More Info][24]


## Become a Housing Technology Subscriber

Becoming a Housing Technology subscriber is completely free and provides you with unparalleled
access to industry insights, news and ideas to help you transform your organisation.

[Free Subscription][25]

[Stonewater logo]

> A truly excellent conference – insightful, inspirational, valuable and well run.

**Stonewater**

> **Great opportunity to spend time with people who are trying to achieve the same goals and the
> sharing of ideas at such a scale is a unique opportunity.**

**Leeds Federated**

> ***Another fantastic Housing Technology Conference, the focused opportunities to share ideas and
> learn from others in the sector around using IT to transform services cannot be missed.***

**St Leger Homes of Doncaster**

> A great conference with very relative information and the best opportunity to network with fellow
> colleagues from the sector.

**Prima Group**

> Excellent chance to meet up with suppliers and housing peers all in one place.

**Housing Solutions**

> The keynote presentations were exciting, radical and transformational. Many thanks for organising
> such a fabulous conference.

**Barnet Homes**

> I wouldn’t really have another housing news outlet.

**Clarion Housing Group**

> Housing Technology provides an excellent range of topics from recognised people and enables
> readers to be able to understand what others are doing in the field.

**Eldon Housing**

> Housing Technology have been invaluable in helping Switchee gain exposure as a disruptive tech
> provider to the social housing sector.

**Switchee**

> Housing Technology provided a great source for content, advice and took care of all logistics. The
> attendees provided positive feedback on the whole experience.

**Rackspace**

## [Delta Cobots Win BIG SEE Product Design Award 2026][3]

**[Delta][4]** - Delta has been honored with the BIG SEE Product Design Award 2026 for the Delta
D-Bot series of collaborative robots. The internationally recognized BIG SEE Awards recognize
outstanding creative achievements in the fields of architecture, product design, and industrial
design. Originally established to promote Southeast Europe (SEE), the award has evolved into a
global platform that celebrates innovation and sustainability.

## [Emerson’s Next-Generation Portable Ultrasonic Flow Meters Offer Greater Flexibility for
## Plant-Wide Transparency][5]

**[Emerson][6]** - Today Emerson released the new Flexim FLUXUS 631 series of portable non-intrusive
clamp-on ultrasonic flow meters. The 631 series delivers flexible, precise and reliable measurement
of liquids, gases and steam in a single platform across a wide range of demanding industrial and
municipal applications without interrupting operations. This enables users to increase maintenance
and energy efficiency and improve plant performance.

## [How a bold engineering idea changed an entire industry and became central to the AI data center
## boom][7]

**[Danfoss][8]** - A new book “The Cool Purpose: The Journey of Danfoss Turbocor in Engineering a
Better Future” chronicles the rich history of the Danfoss Turbocor compressor, the world's first
oil-free magnetic bearing compressor. Turbocor was founded in the mid-1990s in Australia by a group
of engineers with a belief that oil-free and magnetic-bearing compressor technology had the
potential to transform the HVAC industry and lead the way toward more sustainable cooling solutions.

## [3M joins Cadillac Formula 1 Team as Official Material Science Partner to accelerate racing
## performance][9]

**[3M][10]** - The Cadillac Formula 1 Team and 3M today announced a multi-year global partnership to
push the limits of innovation in the world's toughest laboratory, Formula 1. As the team's Official
Material Science Partner, 3M scientists and engineers will work closely with the Cadillac Formula 1
Team to support car development, advance performance and streamline operations.

## [3M and Airbus announce agreement to advance A220 passenger comfort and aircraft performance
## through advanced insulation technology][11]

**[3M][12]** - 3M and Airbus, a leading aircraft manufacturer, have signed a long-term supply
agreement to help drive the continued advancement of passenger comfort and aircraft performance on
the Airbus A220. The agreement underscores both companies' commitment to innovation in aircraft
design and passenger experience.

## [Emerson Adds Combustible Gas Detection to Core Wireless Sensor for Enhanced Safety Coverage in
## Hard-to-Reach Areas][13]

**[Emerson][14]** - Emerson has expanded the capabilities of its Rosemount 928 Wireless Gas Monitor
by adding combustible gas detection, enabling percent lower explosive limit (%LEL) monitoring over
the secure WirelessHART platform. The update helps users monitor combustible hazards in remote or
hard‑to‑wire locations without the need for additional power or costly signal wiring.

## [Lifetime Achievement for pioneer in power-conversion technology behind electric grids][15]

**[European Patent Office][16]** - For his outstanding career in power electronics and grid
infrastructure, the European Patent Office (EPO) has announced that Rainer Marquardt is the
recipient of the Lifetime Achievement distinction for the European Inventor Award 2026. The EPO will
honour his work during the ceremony livestreamed from Berlin on 2 July 2026, at which the winners of
the Industry, Non-EPO Countries, Research and SMEs categories will also be announced.

## [€23 million Data Space Accelerator launched to fast-track SME integration within the Catena-X
## ecosystem][17]

**[Catena-X][18]** - Catena-X and the International Data Spaces Association (IDSA) have announced
the launch of the Data Space Accelerator, a €23 million programme funded by the German Federal
Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy (BMWE). The programme forms part of a German
government-funded study designed to investigate how industrial data spaces scale and the value they
deliver once critical mass is achieved.

## [Honeywell Strengthens OT Cybersecurity Suite for Resilience Against Next Generation of
## Industrial Cyber Threats][19]

**[Honeywell][20]** - Honeywell today announced the expansion of its Operational Technology (OT)
Cybersecurity Suite, delivering advanced, proactive protection for industrial environments facing an
accelerating wave of sophisticated cyber threats. The enhanced portfolio integrates powerful new
capabilities designed to defend critical infrastructure, streamline security compliance, and assist
organizations to stay ahead of increasingly complex attacks.

## [Hexagon helps manufacturers verify and optimise NC programs faster with NCSIMUL][21]

**[Hexagon]

## [Hexagon helps manufacturers verify and optimise NC programs faster with NCSIMUL][21]

**[Hexagon][22]** - Hexagon’s Production Software Division has announced the latest release of
NCSIMUL, strengthening its integrated approach to NC program verification, simulation, and
optimisation with a new Selective Simulation capability. NCSIMUL brings G-code verification, CNC
simulation, and optimisation together in one digital twin environment. Manufacturers use it to check
NC programs, improve machining efficiency, and reduce the need to prove out work on valuable machine
tools.

## [Advancing quantum processor manufacturing: Air Liquide invests in start-up Quobly][23]

**[Air Liquide][24]** - Air Liquide has announced an investment in the French start-up Quobly,
through the Group’s corporate venture capital arm, ALIAD. Quobly develops quantum processors using
proven semiconductor manufacturing processes. This strategic partnership supports the shift from
fundamental research to industrial-scale manufacturing. This investment underlines Air Liquide's
role as a key partner in the quantum computing value chain.

## [Unitree Announces H2 Plus, an NVIDIA Isaac GR00T Reference Humanoid Robot for Academic
## Research][25]

**[Unitree][26]** - Unitree today announced the H2 Plus, the first humanoid robot reference design
built on the NVIDIA Isaac GR00T development platform. The reference design helps democratize
frontier humanoid robotics research by providing access to advanced hardware and an open software
stack without requiring proprietary platforms.

## [Honeywell Launches Enhanced Industrial Software to Deliver Real-Time Visibility into Worksite
## Safety][27]

**[Honeywell][28]** - Honeywell today announced the launch of enhanced capabilities for its Safety
Suite 2.0 software platform, providing broader visibility into portable gas detection device fleets
for safety leaders in refineries, chemical plants, utilities and first responder operations.

## [Pulse of Quality in Manufacturing 2026 survey reveals surge in AI adoption][29]

**[Octave][30]** - The third annual Pulse of Quality in Manufacturing survey was released today by
Octave, the global leader in software for the world’s most critical facilities and infrastructure.
This year’s survey reveals that the overwhelming majority of manufacturers are either using AI today
or plan to use it within the next two years. It also indicates that quality is rapidly emerging as a
core business driver.

## [Enhanced order picking concept][31]

**[Linde Material Handling][32]** - Linde Material Handling (MH) has further refined its unique
vehicle concept with the release of the Linde N20 and N25 horizontal order pickers. This concept,
unparalleled in the industry, features a battery positioned behind the operator's stand. The new
order picker version with an integrated Li-ION battery now is the most compact on the market,
enabling operators to access goods more quickly and maneuver more easily in tight spaces.

## [PLCopen Releases Motion Control Part 4 Version 2.0][33]

**[PLCopen][34]** - Imagine being able to control robots from different manufacturers using the same
familiar PLC programming approach, regardless of the PLC platform being used. With the official
release of PLCopen Motion Control Part 4 Version 2.0, this vision has taken a major step forward.

## [IFC 400: Setting new standards in electromagnetic flow measurement][35]

**[Krohne][36]** - The IFC 400 is a 4-wire signal converter for use with the proven sensors of the
OPTIFLUX and WATERFLUX families. Typical areas of application include the chemical and petrochemical
industries, water and wastewater applications, the food and beverage industry, and the mining and
energy sectors.

## [BASF Coatings future proofs Automotive Refinish through application expertise in robotics][37]

**[BASF][38]** - BASF Coatings is strengthening its role in robotics-enabled Automotive Refinish by
combining coatings expertise, digital color management and application process know-how. Through
close collaboration with OEMs and automation partners, the company aims to help shape the future of
automated paint application in body shops.

## [Schindler expands elevator installation robot fleet as global demand continues to rise][39]

**[Schindler][40]** - Schindler is expanding its fleet of construction robots, adding two new units
of its Robotic Installation System for Elevators (Schindler R.I.S.E). The expansion comes amid
growing global demand for high-tech construction solutions that enhance safety, boost efficiency,
and reduce the physical strain of on-site labor. The company is now operating seven robots
worldwide, delivering time savings of up to 40% during elevator shaft preparation and installation.

## [ABB expands portfolio with new IP66 / Type 4X drives for demanding environments][41]

**[ABB][42]** - ABB has extended its all-compatible drive portfolio with the introduction of IP66 /
UL Type 4X rated variants across its ACS580 General Purpose, ACH580 HVACR, and ACQ580 Water &
Wastewater drive families. Purpose-built for the most demanding operating environments, the new
drives can withstand extreme rain, heat, cold, salt spray, hosing down, dust, cleaning agents and
humidity, where conventional drives would fall short.

Better Future” chronicles the rich history of the Danfoss Turbocor compressor, the world's first
oil-free magnetic bearing compressor. Turbocor was founded in the mid-1990s in Australia by a group
of engineers with a belief that oil-free and magnetic-bearing compressor technology had the
potential to transform the HVAC industry and lead the way toward more sustainable cooling solutions.

## [3M joins Cadillac Formula 1 Team as Official Material Science Partner to accelerate racing
## performance][9]

**[3M][10]** - The Cadillac Formula 1 Team and 3M today announced a multi-year global partnership to
push the limits of innovation in the world's toughest laboratory, Formula 1. As the team's Official
Material Science Partner, 3M scientists and engineers will work closely with the Cadillac Formula 1
Team to support car development, advance performance and streamline operations.

## [3M and Airbus announce agreement to advance A220 passenger comfort and aircraft performance
## through advanced insulation technology][11]

**[3M][12]** - 3M and Airbus, a leading aircraft manufacturer, have signed a long-term supply
agreement to help drive the continued advancement of passenger comfort and aircraft performance on
the Airbus A220. The agreement underscores both companies' commitment to innovation in aircraft
design and passenger experience.

## [Emerson Adds Combustible Gas Detection to Core Wireless Sensor for Enhanced Safety Coverage in
## Hard-to-Reach Areas][13]

**[Emerson][14]** - Emerson has expanded the capabilities of its Rosemount 928 Wireless Gas Monitor
by adding combustible gas detection, enabling percent lower explosive limit (%LEL) monitoring over
the secure WirelessHART platform. The update helps users monitor combustible hazards in remote or
hard‑to‑wire locations without the need for additional power or costly signal wiring.

## [Lifetime Achievement for pioneer in power-conversion technology behind electric grids][15]

**[European Patent Office][16]** - For his outstanding career in power electronics and grid
infrastructure, the European Patent Office (EPO) has announced that Rainer Marquardt is the
recipient of the Lifetime Achievement distinction for the European Inventor Award 2026. The EPO will
honour his work during the ceremony livestreamed from Berlin on 2 July 2026, at which the winners of
the Industry, Non-EPO Countries, Research and SMEs categories will also be announced.

## [€23 million Data Space Accelerator launched to fast-track SME integration within the Catena-X
## ecosystem][17]

**[Catena-X][18]** - Catena-X and the International Data Spaces Association (IDSA) have announced
the launch of the Data Space Accelerator, a €23 million programme funded by the German Federal
Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy (BMWE). The programme forms part of a German
government-funded study designed to investigate how industrial data spaces scale and the value they
deliver once critical mass is achieved.

## [Honeywell Strengthens OT Cybersecurity Suite for Resilience Against Next Generation of
## Industrial Cyber Threats][19]

**[Honeywell][20]** - Honeywell today announced the expansion of its Operational Technology (OT)
Cybersecurity Suite, delivering advanced, proactive protection for industrial environments facing an
accelerating wave of sophisticated cyber threats. The enhanced portfolio integrates powerful new
capabilities designed to defend critical infrastructure, streamline security compliance, and assist
organizations to stay ahead of increasingly complex attacks.

## [Hexagon helps manufacturers verify and optimise NC programs faster with NCSIMUL][21]

**[Hexagon][22]** - Hexagon’s Production Software Division has announced the latest release of
NCSIMUL, strengthening its integrated approach to NC program verification, simulation, and
optimisation with a new Selective Simulation capability. NCSIMUL brings G-code verification, CNC
simulation, and optimisation together in one digital twin environment. Manufacturers use it to check
NC programs, improve machining efficiency, and reduce the need to prove out work on valuable machine
tools.

## [Advancing quantum processor manufacturing: Air Liquide invests in start-up Quobly][23]

**[Air Liquide][24]** - Air Liquide has announced an investment in the French start-up Quobly,
through the Group’s corporate venture capital arm, ALIAD. Quobly develops quantum processors using
proven semiconductor manufacturing processes. This strategic partnership supports the shift from
fundamental research to industrial-scale manufacturing. This investment underlines Air Liquide's
role as a key partner in the quantum computing value chain.

## [Unitree Announces H2 Plus, an NVIDIA Isaac GR00T Reference Humanoid Robot for Academic
## Research][25]

**[Unitree][26]** - Unitree today announced the H2 Plus, the first humanoid robot reference design
built on the NVIDIA Isaac GR00T development platform. The reference design helps democratize
frontier humanoid robotics research by providing access to advanced hardware and an open software
stack without requiring proprietary platforms.

## [Honeywell Launches Enhanced Industrial Software to Deliver Real-Time Visibility into Worksite
## Safety][27]

**[Honeywell][28]** - Honeywell today announced the launch of enhanced capabilities for its Safety
Suite 2.0 software platform, providing broader visibility into portable gas detection device fleets
for safety leaders in refineries, chemical plants, utilities and first responder operations.

## [Pulse of Quality in Manufacturing 2026 survey reveals surge in AI adoption][29]

**[Octave][30]** - The third annual Pulse of Quality in Manufacturing survey was released today by
Octave, the global leader in software for the world’s most critical facilities and infrastructure.
This year’s survey reveals that the overwhelming majority of manufacturers are either using AI today
or plan to use it within the next two years. It also indicates that quality is rapidly emerging as a
core business driver.

## [Enhanced order picking concept][31]

**[Linde Material Handling][32]** - Linde Material Handling (MH) has further refined its unique
vehicle concept with the release of the Linde N20 and N25 horizontal order pickers. This concept,
unparalleled in the industry, features a battery positioned behind the operator's stand. The new
order picker version with an integrated Li-ION battery now is the most compact on the market,
enabling operators to access goods more quickly and maneuver more easily in tight spaces.

## [PLCopen Releases Motion Control Part 4 Version 2.0][33]

**[PLCopen][34]** - Imagine being able to control robots from different manufacturers using the same
familiar PLC programming approach, regardless of the PLC platform being used. With the official
release of PLCopen Motion Control Part 4 Version 2.0, this vision has taken a major step forward.

## [IFC 400: Setting new standards in electromagnetic flow measurement][35]

**[Krohne][36]** - The IFC 400 is a 4-wire signal converter for use with the proven sensors of the
OPTIFLUX and WATERFLUX families. Typical areas of application include the chemical and petrochemical
industries, water and wastewater applications, the food and beverage industry, and the mining and
energy sectors.

## [BASF Coatings future proofs Automotive Refinish through application expertise in robotics][37]

**[BASF][38]** - BASF Coatings is strengthening its role in robotics-enabled Automotive Refinish by
combining coatings expertise, digital color management and application process know-how. Through
close collaboration with OEMs and automation partners, the company aims to help shape the future of
automated paint application in body shops.

## [Schindler expands elevator installation robot fleet as global demand continues to rise][39]

**[Schindler][40]** - Schindler is expanding its fleet of construction robots, adding two new units
of its Robotic Installation System for Elevators (Schindler R.I.S.E). The expansion comes amid
growing global demand for high-tech construction solutions that enhance safety, boost efficiency,
and reduce the physical strain of on-site labor. The company is now operating seven robots
worldwide, delivering time savings of up to 40% during elevator shaft preparation and installation.

## [ABB expands portfolio with new IP66 / Type 4X drives for demanding environments][41]

**[ABB][42]** - ABB has extended its all-compatible drive portfolio with the introduction of IP66 /
UL Type 4X rated variants across its ACS580 General Purpose, ACH580 HVACR, and ACQ580 Water &
Wastewater drive families. Purpose-built for the most demanding operating environments, the new
drives can withstand extreme rain, heat, cold, salt spray, hosing down, dust, cleaning agents and
humidity, where conventional drives would fall short.

advanced hospital departments.

service workflows.

# America.

J+H Automation Solutions is a full-service material handling and automation engineering company. We
design, build, install, and maintain custom machinery, conveyors, robotics, and control systems that
increase flexibility, improve efficiency, and maximize profitability.

## A multi-solution systems integrator and full-service engineering firm

For 40 years, J+H Automation Solutions has specialized in material handling systems, automation
systems, industrial machinery, and control systems design. Proudly serving North America.

[J+H Automation Solutions engineering service icon]

### Turnkey Engineer-Build-Install

System layout, mechanical and controls design, project management, and in-house installation teams —
one partner from concept to startup.

[Learn More →][62]

### Conveyors & Material Handling

Belt, roller, chain, power-and-free, I-beam, and spiral conveyor systems, plus ergonomic cranes,
hoists, and lifts — standard and fully custom.

[Learn More →][63]
[J+H Automation Solutions robotics service icon]

### Robotics & Automated Vehicles

Robotic cells, machine tending, end-of-arm tooling, and Daifuku® SmartCart AGC systems, integrated
into complete work cells.

[Learn More →][64]
[J+H Automation Solutions controls and integration service icon]

### Controls & Integration

In-house PLC and HMI programming, control system design, and panel fabrication in our own UL® Listed
panel shop.

Purpose-built machines designed, fabricated, and tested in our own facility when off-the-shelf
equipment can't do the job.

Authorized integrator for ABB®, Fanuc®, Daifuku®, Roach®, Cognex®, Ignition®, Allen-Bradley®, and

system integrators like JS Controls analyze your manufacturing, material handling, or inspection
lines; determine which areas could be improved; and install the automation technology in those
areas. There are typically two main applications for robotics integration — industrial robotics and
collaborative robotics.

Industrial robotic systems are machines designed to complete repetitive actions in industrial
settings. These robots can be multi-axis robotic arms, automated guided vehicles, automated cells,
or conveyance. Modern advancements have made these systems flexible and scalable....

# Custom Robotic Integrator

Leaders in robotic automation since 1990.

[ Talk to a certified integrator ][39]

## Turn high stakes into high performance.

The stakes are too high to partner with anything less than an experienced team of robotic
integrators. We work with you to increase productivity and deliver the ROI you need. That’s what we
do for our clients.

We understand how daunting automation can be. As engineers ourselves, precision is the only
acceptable path. That’s why we meticulously prove out a robotic solution that targets your core
problems. Clients from NASA to Toyota trust us to deliver precise, flexible solutions that deliver
on efficiency, ROI, timing, and budget.

[ Talk to a certified integrator ][40]
^{Core capabilities}
* Welding
* Assembly
* Cutting, grinding, & finishing
* Material handling & tending
* CNC machine tending
* Injection mold machine tending
* Pre-engineered solutions
* ### Welding
  
  KC Robotics is an industry leader for integrating automated welding systems. Our process expertise
  in Robotic Arc Welding, Laser welding, and Additive Manufacturing will help you decrease
  manufacturing costs, improve productivity, and increase weld quality.
  
  [ Learn more ][41]
* ### Assembly
  
  KC Robotics will show you the benefits of automation for your assembly process. We partner with
  your team to design, engineer and build a solution that enhances your production line and improves
  the quality and consistency of the assembled product.
  
  [ Learn more ][42]
* ### Cutting, grinding, & finishing
  
  KC Robotics is an industry leader in Robotic cutting trimming and finishing systems. Our years of
  experience utilizing high speed routers, ultrasonic knives and lasers give us a depth of knowledge
  to design and implement a robotic system that will improve productivity, quality, reliability and
  safety in your manufacturing processes.
  
  [ Learn more ][43]
* ### Material handling & tending
  
  KC Robotics designs and builds robotic material handling systems that fit your specific needs.
  From simple pick and place solutions to CNC Machine Tending or customized part handling lines, KC
  Robotics will implement a robotic system to improve productivity, quality and reliability in your
  manufacturing processes.
  
  [ Learn more ][44]
* ### CNC machine tending
  
  Finding qualified skilled labor for your CNC Machining operation is more difficult than ever. KC
  Robotics offers complete robotic CNC loading and tending systems. Our straight-forward plan will
  help your company get on the right track to success.
  
  [ Learn more ][45]
* ### Injection mold machine tending
  
  Automated injection molding solves multiple manufacturing concerns – safety, operation costs and
  quality. KC Robotics offers robotic injection mold tending systems for progressive consumer goods
  manufacturers.
  
  [ Learn more ][46]
* ### Pre-engineered solutions
  
  Pre-Engineered and Standard Robotic Solutions from KC Robotics provide a high quality system with
  lower equipment costs and a faster implementation time through standardization. KC Robotics offers
  several systems for Arc Welding, Cutting and CNC Machine Tending.
  
  [ Learn more ][47]
^{Why choose KC Robotics?}

## Benefits of partnering with us

At KC Robotics, we don't sell a product; we sell custom solutions tailored to your specifications.
Beginning with the sales process, our focus is on design concepts. We prove out our designs during
engineering approval and work with your team through engineering, programming and installation to
ensure that your robotic system provides the solution you need.

### Experience

Trust your automation project to robotic integrators with problem-solving experience.

### Expertise

Engineering, Design, Programming, Project Management, Robotic applications

### Partnership

Gain a strong, reliable partner

# Custom Robotic Integrator

Leaders in robotic automation since 1990.

[ Talk to a certified integrator ][39]

## Turn high stakes into high performance.

The stakes are too high to partner with anything less than an experienced team of robotic
integrators. We work with you to increase productivity and deliver the ROI you need. That’s what we
do for our clients.

We understand how daunting automation can be. As engineers ourselves, precision is the only
acceptable path. That’s why we meticulously prove out a robotic solution that targets your core
problems. Clients from NASA to Toyota trust us to deliver precise, flexible solutions that deliver
on efficiency, ROI, timing, and budget.

[ Talk to a certified integrator ][40]
^{Core capabilities}
* Welding
* Assembly
* Cutting, grinding, & finishing
* Material handling & tending
* CNC machine tending
* Injection mold machine tending
* Pre-engineered solutions
* ### Welding
  
  KC Robotics is an industry leader for integrating automated welding systems. Our process expertise
  in Robotic Arc Welding, Laser welding, and Additive Manufacturing will help you decrease
  manufacturing costs, improve productivity, and increase weld quality.
  
  [ Learn more ][41]
* ### Assembly
  
  KC Robotics will show you the benefits of automation for your assembly process. We partner with
  your team to design, engineer and build a solution that enhances your production line and improves
  the quality and consistency of the assembled product.
  
  [ Learn more ][42]
* ### Cutting, grinding, & finishing
  
  KC Robotics is an industry leader in Robotic cutting trimming and finishing systems. Our years of
  experience utilizing high speed routers, ultrasonic knives and lasers give us a depth of knowledge
  to design and implement a robotic system that will improve productivity, quality, reliability and
  safety in your manufacturing processes.
  
  [ Learn more ][43]
* ### Material handling & tending
  
  KC Robotics designs and builds robotic material handling systems that fit your specific needs.
  From simple pick and place solutions to CNC Machine Tending or customized part handling lines, KC
  Robotics will implement a robotic system to improve productivity, quality and reliability in your
  manufacturing processes.
  
  [ Learn more ][44]
* ### CNC machine tending
  
  Finding qualified skilled labor for your CNC Machining operation is more difficult than ever. KC
  Robotics offers complete robotic CNC loading and tending systems. Our straight-forward plan will
  help your company get on the right track to success.
  
  [ Learn more ][45]
* ### Injection mold machine tending
  
  Automated injection molding solves multiple manufacturing concerns – safety, operation costs and
  quality. KC Robotics offers robotic injection mold tending systems for progressive consumer goods
  manufacturers.
  
  [ Learn more ][46]
* ### Pre-engineered solutions
  
  Pre-Engineered and Standard Robotic Solutions from KC Robotics provide a high quality system with
  lower equipment costs and a faster implementation time through standardization. KC Robotics offers
  several systems for Arc Welding, Cutting and CNC Machine Tending.
  
  [ Learn more ][47]
^{Why choose KC Robotics?}

## Benefits of partnering with us

At KC Robotics, we don't sell a product; we sell custom solutions tailored to your specifications.
Beginning with the sales process, our focus is on design concepts. We prove out our designs during
engineering approval and work with your team through engineering, programming and installation to
ensure that your robotic system provides the solution you need.

### Experience

Trust your automation project to robotic integrators with problem-solving experience.

### Expertise

Engineering, Design, Programming, Project Management, Robotic applications

### Partnership

Gain a strong, reliable partner

engineers bring you decades of experience and an expansive toolkit to solve your problems.

builders. You’re in the right place. Because Kinemetrix has deep roots serving lean organizations.

integrator allows us to offer and support the latest robotic technologies: 3D robot vision guidance,
conveyor tracking, force feedback, AgileArm™ servo End-of-Arm Tooling, servo-coordinated robotic
dispensing, etc. We maintain an active R&D lab to create new technology, hone our skills, and test
new applications in a safe environment.

Our headquarters is convenient to manufacturers along the I-75 corridor: Kentucky, Tennessee,
Indiana, Ohio, Illinois, Michigan. And Kinemetrix systems operate successfully across the US,
Canada, Mexico, Europe, and Asia.

We invite you to check out some of the more popular topics here:

### Productivity

Efficient forklift trucks are the backbone of efficient intra-company logistics. Together with
intelligent software and comprehensive service packages, operators achieve lasting competitive
advantages.

[ More details here ][205]

### Safety

The safety of people, trucks, and goods is the central idea of Linde Material Handling’s Zero
Accident Philosophy. With integrated solutions, Linde is working toward a future of safer
intralogistics.

[ More details here ][206]

The best solutions arise when humans and technology work together in perfect harmony. The principle
of ergonomic design therefore strongly informs Linde Material Handling’s development of trucks and
services.

### Productivity

Efficient forklift trucks are the backbone of efficient intra-company logistics. Together with
intelligent software and comprehensive service packages, operators achieve lasting competitive
advantages.

[ More details here ][205]

### Safety

The safety of people, trucks, and goods is the central idea of Linde Material Handling’s Zero
Accident Philosophy. With integrated solutions, Linde is working toward a future of safer
intralogistics.

[ More details here ][206]

### Ergonomics

The best solutions arise when humans and technology work together in perfect harmony. The principle
of ergonomic design therefore strongly informs Linde Material Handling’s development of trucks and
services.

Many of the companies we work with already have automation in place. Motion Controls Robotics helps
teams improve reliability, simplify operation, and identify where an upgrade, retrofit, or new

Not every issue calls for a full replacement. Sometimes the right move is service, a controls
update, or a targeted system improvement.

We help you sort out what is worth fixing, what should be improved, and where automation can better
support production.

As a FANUC Level 4 Certified Servicing Integrator with decades of industrial robotics experience
dating back to 1995, we help businesses of all shapes and sizes streamline processes, reduce costs,
fit more capability into less space, and actually achieve the ROI they’ve been seeking through
customized robotic solutions.

When you’re faced with the challenges of today and the demands of the future, we are here to lend a
helping hand, with lifetime customer service that is anything but robotic.
