# Shaping the Future with Smart Robotic Solutions

We deliver precision-engineered components and tailored solutions that help industries build
smarter, more reliable systems.

Let’s build the future of automation together – [contact us][207] now.


## Innovating the Future of Automation Together

We specialize in designing and building custom components for robots,

enabling businesses to develop tailored automation systems.

Here's how we do it:
* We create **custom components** when standard parts don’t meet the needs.
* Our solutions enhance **performance, reliability, and scalability**, overcoming technical
  obstacles.
* We provide **end-to-end support**, from requirements definition to production-ready integration.
* Our **collaborative approach** ensures each component fits your specific environment, throughput
  goals, and long-term vision.
* The result: **smarter automation and greater machine autonomy** across your processes.
* We design each solution as a seamless part of your overall **robotics systems**, ensuring
  mechanical, electrical, and control-level compatibility for smooth integration and long-term
  operational efficiency.

For more about our approach, visit our **About Us** page.

## Commitment to Quality Standards

Norck Robotics, as a division of [Norck][208], proudly operates under [ISO
9001:2015][209] certification.

Key aspects include:
* International Standards: Ensuring all processes align with globally recognized quality benchmarks.
* Customer Centric Approach: Prioritizing customer satisfaction through consistent and reliable
  service.
* Continuous Improvement: Emphasizing the optimization of operations and workflows.
* Operational Excellence: Maintaining efficiency and reliability in all activities.

This certification reflects Norck Robotics’ ongoing commitment to quality and performance.

View our [ISO certification standards][210] and compliance documentation.

From a single prototype to full-scale production, we provide the end-to-end manufacturing solutions
your robotic systems demand.

Building the Future of Robotics, One Custom Part at a Time

We empower robotic innovation by transforming ambitious prototypes into reliable, mass-produced
components. Your vision, our manufacturing expertise.

smarter, more reliable systems.

Let’s build the future of automation together – [contact us][207] now.


## Innovating the Future of Automation Together

We specialize in designing and building custom components for robots,

enabling businesses to develop tailored automation systems.

Here's how we do it:
* We create **custom components** when standard parts don’t meet the needs.
* Our solutions enhance **performance, reliability, and scalability**, overcoming technical
  obstacles.
* We provide **end-to-end support**, from requirements definition to production-ready integration.
* Our **collaborative approach** ensures each component fits your specific environment, throughput
  goals, and long-term vision.
* The result: **smarter automation and greater machine autonomy** across your processes.
* We design each solution as a seamless part of your overall **robotics systems**, ensuring
  mechanical, electrical, and control-level compatibility for smooth integration and long-term
  operational efficiency.

For more about our approach, visit our **About Us** page.

## Commitment to Quality Standards

Norck Robotics, as a division of [Norck][208], proudly operates under [ISO
9001:2015][209] certification.

Key aspects include:
* International Standards: Ensuring all processes align with globally recognized quality benchmarks.
* Customer Centric Approach: Prioritizing customer satisfaction through consistent and reliable
  service.
* Continuous Improvement: Emphasizing the optimization of operations and workflows.
* Operational Excellence: Maintaining efficiency and reliability in all activities.

This certification reflects Norck Robotics’ ongoing commitment to quality and performance.

View our [ISO certification standards][210] and compliance documentation.

production-ready parts with unmatched speed and precision.

Your Single Source for Custom Robotic Parts

###### Technology Spotlight

have different housing profiles and mounting. Both feature 16-bit resolution and independent
linearity of ±1°. Sealed to IP67. Both continue to track and save position and count during power

###### Featured Position Sensor Applications
* 
  
  Commercial combine/mower: Accurately measuring position of mower arms as they are lowered, raised
  or locked in position. Click on photo to learn more.
  
  [ ][71]
* 
  
  Wakeboard Wave: Control of a horizontal surface that enables a watersports boat to create
  controllable wakes and waves that for wakeboarding. Click on photo to learn more.

  NASCAR and F1 Race Cars: steering-angle pickup. Click on photo to learn more or see other
  applications.

  photo to learn more or see other applications.
  
  [ ][74]

  A linear position sensor enables automated adjustment of the height of a robotic tool trolley used
  in automotive assembly and other manufacturing plants. Click on photo to learn more.
  
  [ ][75]

  London Eye: sensing the loading ramp position. Click on photo to learn more or see other
  applications.

sensors and angle sensors are used in. Our [Products page][78] has interactive selector guides to
help you choose the best sensor based on your criteria.

MB1 Series of 44-turn non-contacting sensors have solid, semi-hollow or hollow-shaft versions.

###### Technology Spotlight

MC1 and MZ1 Series of 44-turn rotary sensors measure turns and angles to 15,840°. These two series
have different housing profiles and mounting. Both feature 16-bit resolution and independent
linearity of ±1°. Sealed to IP67. Both continue to track and save position and count during power
loss. [Learn more][70].

###### Featured Position Sensor Applications
*

  or locked in position. Click on photo to learn more.

  controllable wakes and waves that for wakeboarding. Click on photo to learn more.

* 
  
  NASCAR and F1 Race Cars: steering-angle pickup. Click on photo to learn more or see other
  applications.
  
  [ ][73]
*

  photo to learn more or see other applications.
  
  [ ][74]
*

  in automotive assembly and other manufacturing plants. Click on photo to learn more.
  
  [ ][75]

  applications.

###### 
###### Choosing the right position sensor


See our [Applications page][77] to read about some of the applications Novotechnik linear position
sensors and angle sensors are used in. Our [Products page][78] has interactive selector guides to
help you choose the best sensor based on your criteria.

MB1 Series of 44-turn non-contacting sensors have solid, semi-hollow or hollow-shaft versions.
Repeatability is less than ±0.1° with galvanized steel housing and stainless steel shaft and
coupling. [Read more][79].

counterbalance forklifts deliver reliable performance for every
warehouse task-from pallet moving to heavy-duty lifting.

## FAQ

Can your robots integrate with MES or WMS systems?

Yes, we provide SDK development kits, example source codes, and open API interfaces to support
integration with MES, ERP, WMS systems, as well as linking with other devices. We also have a
professional technical support team.

Can your transport robots move goods between floors?

Yes, they can be equipped with the functionality to use elevators. However, we need to assess
whether the elevator is compatible with our elevator control module. You'll need to fill out an
elevator control information collection form for our engineers to evaluate.

Can your machines control electric doors?

Door control is supported. We will provide the necessary modules and guide you through the
installation and deployment process.

Do your factory delivery robots require floor markings or magnetic strips?

No, they do not. Our robots use pure laser navigation which is easy to map, and they autonomously
plan routes without needing floor markings.

How is your robot's obstacle avoidance? Is it safe?

Our robots use lidar and 3D vision for obstacle avoidance, achieving millisecond-level avoidance.
After avoiding an obstacle, they can autonomously find a new route. The travel speed is adjustable.
Our batteries are lithium iron phosphate, known for stability, and they include automatic power-off
and overcurrent protection, making them suitable even for first-class warehouses.

Are your robot batteries safe?

Our batteries are lithium iron phosphate, which is very stable. They can withstand temperatures up
to 800 degrees with thermal and humidity control, and they include automatic power-off and
overcurrent protection.

## ResinDek Flooring: Cost-Effective Alternative to Concrete Decking

Converting from concrete to ResinDek panels reduces structural steel requirements, lowering material
and installation costs while accelerating project timelines. Factory-finished panels eliminate field
coatings and concrete curing time, enabling immediate equipment deployment. With lower embodied
carbon and recyclable materials, ResinDek delivers a cost-effective, environmentally responsible
alternative to concrete decking.

## Precision Flooring for Ground Floor Robotics

Uneven concrete floors with cracks and spalling disrupt AGV and AMR navigation. ResinDek panels
overlay existing floors to create a level, durable surface engineered for robotic operations.
Lab-tested by AGV and AMR manufacturers, ResinDek delivers the wear resistance and flatness
autonomous vehicles require.

[ Learn More ][189]

## How ResinDek Flooring Reduces Costs for Self-Storage Facilities

ResinDek composite wood flooring panels deliver exceptional value for multi-story self-storage
facilities. The panels provide concrete-like structural strength with significant cost savings—often
tens of thousands of dollars per project. Built to handle demanding loads—supporting up to 125 psf.
uniform loads and rolling pallet jacks weighing up to 8,000 lbs. (3,360 kg).

ResinDek Shelving System is an engineered solution for storing and supporting case goods in
warehouse, distribution, and manufacturing facilities. The system integrates ResinDek horizontal

installation.

### Консалтинг, аудит и имитационное моделирование для складов

Проверяем решения на цифровых двойниках ещё до внедрения и анализируем текущие процессы для
разработки стратегии полной автоматизации. Моделируем десятки сценариев работы склада, оптимизируем
ресурсы, маршруты роботов и операции сотрудников, чтобы обеспечить бесперебойную работу даже при
пиковых нагрузках.

## Почему выбирают нас

### Гибкое масштабирование

Мы не просто запускаем роботов — мы создаём платформу для гибкой модернизации склада. С ростом
бизнеса вы сможете добавлять новых роботов и оборудование, что позволит снизить капитальные
и операционные расходы и повысить общую эффективность склада.

### Yandex Robotics Platform — платформа для беспрерывной роботизации

Yandex Robotics Platform — платформа для управления разным оборудованием от любых вендоров,
ускорения интеграции и вывода данных с устройств в удобные дашборды. Подходит как для новых
проектов, так и для уже работающей инфраструктуры.

### Отсутствие vendor lock

Позволяет подключать тех роботов, которые подходят лучше всего, без привязки к одному производителю.
Проект можно начать на оборудовании одного вендора и масштабировать с другими партнёрами, а YRP
остаётся универсальным инструментом для управления роботизацией.

### Технический консалтинг и имитационное моделирование

Предлагаем инструменты для создания цифровых двойников и имитационного моделирования склада ещё
до закупки роботов. Аудит помогает выявить узкие места, подобрать технологии и оценить
эффективность. Моделирование разных сценариев позволяет выбрать самое производительное и выгодное
решение.

### Открытость и гибкость

Наши открытые API и интеграционные возможности позволяют добавлять новые функции и оборудование.
Ваш склад всегда будет соответствовать вашим растущим потребностям, а гибкая система позволит
эффективно справляться с пиковыми нагрузками на складе.

### Поддержка

Наша команда всегда на связи и готова оказать любой уровень поддержки на своих проектах. Неважно,
поставляем мы собственное оборудование или роботов сторонних вендоров. Своевременное обслуживание
и оперативная помощь в случае инцидента — гарантия эффективности вашего бизнеса.

### Консалтинг, аудит и имитационное моделирование для складов

Проверяем решения на цифровых двойниках ещё до внедрения и анализируем текущие процессы для
разработки стратегии полной автоматизации. Моделируем десятки сценариев работы склада, оптимизируем
ресурсы, маршруты роботов и операции сотрудников, чтобы обеспечить бесперебойную работу даже при
пиковых нагрузках.

## Почему выбирают нас

### Гибкое масштабирование

Мы не просто запускаем роботов — мы создаём платформу для гибкой модернизации склада. С ростом
бизнеса вы сможете добавлять новых роботов и оборудование, что позволит снизить капитальные
и операционные расходы и повысить общую эффективность склада.

### Yandex Robotics Platform — платформа для беспрерывной роботизации

Yandex Robotics Platform — платформа для управления разным оборудованием от любых вендоров,
ускорения интеграции и вывода данных с устройств в удобные дашборды. Подходит как для новых
проектов, так и для уже работающей инфраструктуры.

### Отсутствие vendor lock

Позволяет подключать тех роботов, которые подходят лучше всего, без привязки к одному производителю.
Проект можно начать на оборудовании одного вендора и масштабировать с другими партнёрами, а YRP
остаётся универсальным инструментом для управления роботизацией.

### Технический консалтинг и имитационное моделирование

Предлагаем инструменты для создания цифровых двойников и имитационного моделирования склада ещё
до закупки роботов. Аудит помогает выявить узкие места, подобрать технологии и оценить
эффективность. Моделирование разных сценариев позволяет выбрать самое производительное и выгодное
решение.

### Открытость и гибкость

Наши открытые API и интеграционные возможности позволяют добавлять новые функции и оборудование.
Ваш склад всегда будет соответствовать вашим растущим потребностям, а гибкая система позволит
эффективно справляться с пиковыми нагрузками на складе.

### Поддержка

Наша команда всегда на связи и готова оказать любой уровень поддержки на своих проектах. Неважно,
поставляем мы собственное оборудование или роботов сторонних вендоров. Своевременное обслуживание
и оперативная помощь в случае инцидента — гарантия эффективности вашего бизнеса.

## Pioneering automation

Rocla AGV Solutions are a full-service answer to your facility’s intralogistics challenges when you
want to ensure reliability, safety and efficiency. Purpose-fit [AGVs,][56] world-leading
[software][57] and [Life Cycle Services][58] are there to ensure that you reduce your material
handling costs and retain your assets’ value.

[Learn more ][59]

## Comprehensive logistic solutions

As a comprehensive solutions provider, we offer a wide range of material handling solutions and
services from [AGVs][60] and [manually operated forklifts][61] to [racking][62], [AGV system
software][63] and intralogistics consultation. Each solution is designed to optimally serve your
specific intralogistics processes. When choosing our complete solution, you can have it all from the
same provider while saving time and resources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

#### Insight Development

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

## What Makes Symbotic a Different Kind of Company

### All-in-One Solution Provider & Technology Innovator

Typical integrators are limited by their portfolio of technology partnerships and are unable to
resolve problems when those technologies misalign. At Symbotic, we provide complete, turnkey-ready,
end-to-end warehouse automation, and as the software and key robotic innovator for each solution, we
can provide solutions to best meet customer needs without limitations.

### Turning Focused R&D into Customer-Centric Solutions

To date, we have invested over $1 billion into research and development, resulting in 1,050+ patents
issued or pending in over 15 countries around the world. We are deeply dedicated to innovating
meaningful and effective technology that keeps pace with ever-evolving changes in the supply chain,
to give our customers a leading edge.

### American Owned, Operated, & Innovated

Founded by Rick Cohen with headquarters in Wilmington (MA), USA, our team provides local support and
understands complex supply chain challenges via deep first-hand experience. Symbotic’s research and
development teams, located around the US, draw from the world’s leading innovative minds to pioneer
groundbreaking technologies that are defining the future of material handing and supply chain
solutions.

Symbotic is not only the leader in industrial automation, but in technology at large— innovating
solutions through robotics and AI for the betterment of material access. Our purpose is to get the
right goods to people who need them, when they need them, and our innovations in robotics and
material handling logistics pursue that mission.

## About Us

Tesca Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is World's Leading ISO Certified Manufacturer & Exporter of Test,
Measuring & Technical Education Equipment. We are Member for Electronics & Computer Software Export
Promotion Council, New Delhi, India having sales in more than 85+ Countries Worldwide.
Tesca's operations are spread out in 23000 Square Feet encompassing more then 2000 manufactured
Innovative Products and Turnkey Project Capabilities for International Tenders. Tesca is an Export
House established in December 2009 with our Registered & Corporate Office both set up at Jaipur.
We are actively doing business in Middle East, CIS, South East Asia, Africa as well as South America
Countries. We do have our representatives in almost all Countries. Please be noted that we are doing
projects meant for School Education, Vocational Training, Laboratory, Health Center, Hospital
Equipment, Agricultural Modernization, Industrial Modernization, Rural Water Supply as well as Small
Scale Enterprises funded by Ministry of Education, World Bank, Asian / African Development Bank as
well as GOI LOC. [Learn more about Tesca Global][36]

## About Us

Tesca Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is World's Leading ISO Certified Manufacturer & Exporter of Test,
Measuring & Technical Education Equipment. We are Member for Electronics & Computer Software Export
Promotion Council, New Delhi, India having sales in more than 85+ Countries Worldwide.
Tesca's operations are spread out in 23000 Square Feet encompassing more then 2000 manufactured
Innovative Products and Turnkey Project Capabilities for International Tenders. Tesca is an Export
House established in December 2009 with our Registered & Corporate Office both set up at Jaipur.
We are actively doing business in Middle East, CIS, South East Asia, Africa as well as South America
Countries. We do have our representatives in almost all Countries. Please be noted that we are doing
projects meant for School Education, Vocational Training, Laboratory, Health Center, Hospital
Equipment, Agricultural Modernization, Industrial Modernization, Rural Water Supply as well as Small
Scale Enterprises funded by Ministry of Education, World Bank, Asian / African Development Bank as
well as GOI LOC. [Learn more about Tesca Global][36]

该节目播出后，突破了文化圈层壁垒，迅速掀起全民模仿风潮。
